SUMMARY: This factory builds a banana / traveller's-palm-like monocot plant: a stem with long paddle-shaped leaves instanced along it via geometry nodes. BananaMonocotFactory defines leaf shape, veins, cuts, and per-plant randomized parameters; TaroMonocotFactory subclasses it for a taro variant with petiole branches. MonocotGrowthFactory (base class) drives the overall growth: leaf-count, per-point rotation/scale along the stem, stem geometry, deformation, and the green shader. To make a strictly one-plane fan (petioles in a single row rather than a radial crown), the key controls are the z_rotation accumulation (angle) and align settings in growth.py plus stem_offset/count in banana.py.

EDITABLE (upper-level files — change these to alter the result):

FILE: assets/objects/monocot/banana.py
  BananaMonocotFactory.__init__: per-plant randomized shape/size parameters (FixedSeed sampled)
    knobs: stem_offset(uniform 0.6-1.0) -> stem height / vertical spread of leaves; angle(uniform pi/4-pi/3) -> azimuthal step between successive leaves (SET SMALL/0 FOR FLAT FAN); z_scale(uniform 1-1.5) -> overall vertical stretch; z_drag(uniform 0.1-0.2) -> downward droop of leaf tips; min_y_angle(uniform 0.05pi-0.1pi) -> tilt of basal leaves; max_y_angle(uniform 0.25pi-0.45pi) -> tilt of topmost leaves; leaf_range((0.5-0.7, 1)) -> fraction of stem bearing leaves; count(log_uniform 16-24) -> number of instance points/leaves; scale_curve([(0,0.4-1.0),(1,0.6-1.0)]) -> leaf size from base to top; radius(uniform 0.04-0.06) -> stem thickness; bud_angle(uniform pi/8-pi/6) -> leaf base bud direction; cut_angle(bud_angle + pi/20..pi/12) -> angle of edge serrations/cuts; freq(log_uniform 100-300) -> vein density; n_cuts(randint 6-10, 80% prob else 0) -> number of leaf-edge cuts
  BananaMonocotFactory.build_base_hue: returns uniform(0.15,0.35) -> green leaf hue
  BananaMonocotFactory.cut_leaf: carves serrated notches into leaf edges
    knobs: y-band select (|y|<0.08 & >0.01) -> which edge strip is cut; ratio(uniform -2.0..0.4) -> cut depth/direction; exponent(uniform 1.2-1.6) -> cut profile sharpness; edge-delete length threshold(0.02) -> how much torn edge removed
  BananaMonocotFactory.build_leaf: defines paddle leaf outline
    knobs: x_anchors(0, 0.2cos(bud), uniform 0.8-1.2, 2.0) -> leaf length; y_anchors(0, 0.2sin(bud), uniform 0.2-0.25, 0) -> leaf width/taper
  BananaMonocotFactory.displace_veins: cosine vein pattern + midrib
    knobs: vein threshold(uniform 0.85-0.9) -> vein sparsity; midrib width(|y|<uniform 0.002-0.008) -> central rib width; displace strength(-uniform 5e-3..8e-3) -> vein depth
  TaroMonocotFactory.__init__: overrides for taro variant
    knobs: stem_offset(0.05-0.1); radius(0.02-0.04); z_drag(0.2-0.3); bud_angle(0.6pi-0.7pi); freq(10-20); count(12-16); n_cuts(1-2, 50% else 0); min_y_angle(-0.25pi..-0.05pi); max_y_angle(-0.05pi..0)
  TaroMonocotFactory.build_leaf: broader shorter leaf + petiole branch, origin lowered
    knobs: x_anchors(...,uniform 0.4-1.0, 0.8-1.0); y_anchors(...,uniform 0.25-0.3,0); decorate_leaf(y_ratio=2, leftmost=False)
  TaroMonocotFactory.build_branch: bezier petiole stalk
    knobs: offset(uniform 0.2-0.3) -> petiole horizontal reach; length(uniform 1-2) -> petiole length; geo_radius(uniform 0.02-0.03, 32) -> petiole thickness

FILE: assets/objects/monocot/growth.py
  MonocotGrowthFactory.__init__: base defaults (overridden by subclasses)
    knobs: count(128) -> stem sample points; perturb(0.05) -> random jitter of rotation/scale; angle(pi/6) -> base azimuthal leaf step; min_y_angle/max_y_angle(0..pi/2) -> leaf tilt range; leaf_prob(uniform 0.8-0.9) -> chance each point gets a leaf; leaf_range(0,1) -> stem span with leaves; stem_offset(0.2); scale_curve; radius(0.01); bend_angle(pi/4); twist_angle(pi/6); z_drag(0); z_scale(uniform 1.0-1.2); align_factor(0)/align_direction((1,0,0)) -> optional alignment of leaves to a vector (RAISE align_factor + set direction to force one-plane fan); base_hue/bright_color/dark_color -> leaf color (hsv, sat 0.6-0.8/0.8-1.0, val log 0.05-0.2)
  MonocotGrowthFactory.decorate_leaf: bends/deforms & textures each leaf
    knobs: y_bend_angle(pi/6)/z_bend_angle(pi/6) -> leaf curl; noise_scale(0.1)/strength(0.02) -> surface bumpiness; y_ratio(4) -> cross-section cupping
  MonocotGrowthFactory.make_geo_flower: places leaves along stem (geometry nodes)
    knobs: z_rotation = AccumulateField(angle*0.95..1.05) -> radial spiral of leaves (KEY: reduce/zero for flat single-row fan); y_rotation curve(min_y_angle->max_y_angle); scale_curve; leaf_prob/leaf_range selection
  MonocotGrowthFactory.build_stem: builds subdivided stem cylinder
    knobs: SUBSURF levels(9); geo_radius(self.radius,16); DISPLACE noise_scale(0.1)/strength(0.01)
  MonocotGrowthFactory.decorate_monocot: whole-plant deform + placement
    knobs: z_drag droop; twist_angle; bend_angle; scale(uniform 0.8-1.2 x/y, z_scale z); random z-rotation(0..2pi)
  MonocotGrowthFactory.create_raw: snaps angle so leaves evenly divide 2pi (affects fan symmetry)
  MonocotGrowthFactory.shader_monocot: leaf material
    knobs: specular(uniform 0.0-0.2); clearcoat(0 80% else 0.2-0.5); color ramp stops [0,0.3,0.7,1.0]; musgrave scale(10); roughness curve(0.5-0.8); noise scale(50); Subsurface Weight(0.01)/Radius(0.01)

FILE: assets/objects/monocot/__init__.py
  module exports: registers BananaMonocotFactory/TaroMonocotFactory (and other monocots); no tunables
